site.metaTitle: SwapSpot - Dugu kɔnɔ dɛmɛ danayalen ɲini
site.metaDescription: Dugu kɔnɔ dɛmɛbaga danayalenw waati ta: saniya, dilanni, cɛɲi, nakɔ labɛnni, yɔrɔ yɛlɛma, bagan marali, mɔgɔ kɔrɔw marali, kalan dɛmɛ ani fɛn wɛrɛw.
site.hero.badge: A bɛ daminɛ i ka dugu kɔnɔ sisan
site.hero.body: Saniya, dilanni, cɛɲi, nakɔ labɛnni, yɔrɔ yɛlɛma dɛmɛ, bagan marali ani fɛn wɛrɛw waati ta dugu sugu kelen na.
site.hero.rating: dugumɔgɔ 2,300+ fɛ · dɛmɛbaga 1,200 bɛ i kɛrɛfɛ
site.hero.review: N ye fɛn dilanbaga dɔ waati ta n ka sira kan miniti 10 kɔnɔ.
site.how.title: Dɛmɛ bɛ digi saba ɲɛ
site.how.body: Ka bɔ "n mako bɛ nin na" la ka se "a waati tara" ma, telefɔni gɛlɛya, hakili-hakili walima sɔngɔ fɔli dibali tɛ.
site.steps.0.1: Dɛmɛbaga danayalenw filɛ karti ɲɛnama kan, jan ni jate ɲɔgɔn fɛ.
site.steps.1.0: Baaraw ni sɔngɔw ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ filɛ
site.steps.1.1: Profiliw, baaraw ani sɔngɔ jirali filɛ sani i ka bɛn.
site.steps.2.0: Waati ta, kuma ani sara lakana la
site.steps.2.1: Cikan ci, sɔngɔ fɔli sɔrɔ ani sara lakana la app kɔnɔ.
site.helpers.title: I ka dɔnniya kɛ sɔrɔ ye i ka dugu kɔnɔ
site.helpers.body: Labɛn siɲɛ kelen ka daminɛ ka waati ta dugumɔgɔw fɛ minnu mako bɛ i ka baara na.
site.helpers.freeTitle: Dɛmɛbagaw ye, a sara tɛ tuma bɛɛ
site.helpers.freeBody: I ka sɔrɔ bɛɛ mara. SwapSpot t'a ta, kɔmisiyɔn tɛ, pɛrisɛntaji tɛ, ani ɲini sara tɛ.
site.perks.0.1: I ka dɔnniya, foto ni baara yɔrɔ lasɛbɛn miniti dɔw kɔnɔ.
site.perks.1.0: I ka sɔngɔw ni waati sigi
site.perks.1.1: I ka sɔngɔw, rayɔn ni waati bɛ i yɛrɛ bolo.
site.perks.2.0: Waati taali sɔrɔ ani sɔngɔ fɔli ci
site.perks.2.1: Ɲini kɛrɛfɛmɔgɔw sɔrɔ ani ka jaabi di ni sɔngɔ fɔli ye.
site.perks.3.1: Jatew sɔrɔ minnu bɛ baara fɔlɔw kɛ ɲinibaga tuma bɛɛ ye.
site.categories.title: Baara o baara, dɛmɛbaga bɛ yen
site.categories.body: Baara suguya fɔlɔw ka daminɛ, ka fara a kan sugu o sugu bonyana.
site.trust.title: A dilannen don walasa fan fila bɛɛ ka lakana sɔrɔ
site.trust.body: Hakilina tiɲɛnw, cikan gundoman ani sirilanw minnu b'a to dugumɔgɔw b'u yɛrɛ ka kunnafoni bolo.
site.trustItems.0.1: Jate tiɲɛnw ka bɔ dugumɔgɔ tiɲɛnw fɛ baara o baara kɔ.
site.trustItems.1.1: Kumaɲɔgɔnya ni sɔngɔ fɔliw to yɔrɔ kelen.
site.trustItems.2.1: Mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ taamasyɛn walima bali tuma o tuma.
site.trustItems.3.1: I ka kɔntɔ ni i ka kunnafoni bɔ tuma min i b'a fɛ.
site.trustItems.4.1: Dɛmɛbagaw bɛ u ka yɔrɔ jirali kɔlɔsi.
site.waitlist.title: SwapSpot ta bi
site.waitlist.body: Dɛmɛbagaw filɛ i kɛrɛfɛ sara tɛ. Paasi baara kɛ ni i labɛnnen don ka cikan ci, sɔngɔ fɔli ɲini walima ka waati ta.

directory.indexMetaDescription: SwapSpot baara jamabɔlen pejiw filɛ ni suguya ni dugu sugu ye. Saniya, dilanni, yɔrɔ yɛlɛma, kalan, bagan marali, cɛɲi, baara dɔnnenw ani fɛn wɛrɛw ɲini.
directory.indexTitle: Dugu dɛmɛbaga baaraw ni suguya ani sugu ye
directory.indexIntro: Nin pejiw bɛ bɔ dɛmɛbaga baara jamabɔlenw na SwapSpot kɔnɔ. U bɛ ɲinibagaw dɛmɛ k'a ye baara misaliw dugu, poso kɔdi, lamini, suguya, sɔngɔ, kan ni jate ye.
directory.byCountryBody: Lyɛn o lyɛn duguma bɛ peji jamabɔlen da wuli. Ni dɛmɛbaga baara yɔrɔ kura jamabɔ, a bɛ bɔ yan ni sayiti mara kuraya kɔ.
directory.emptyBody: Lisiti in bɛ bɔ dɛmɛbaga baara jamabɔlenw na. Ni lyɛn tɛ yan fɔlɔ, segin tuma dɔɔnin kɔ walima app da wuli ka dɛmɛbagaw filɛ i kɛrɛfɛ.
directory.pairMetaDescription: {categoryLower} dɛmɛbagaw ɲini {market} kɔnɔ. Baara misaliw, baara yɔrɔw, sɔngɔw, kanw ani jatew filɛ sani i ka SwapSpot da wuli.
directory.pairOgDescription: {categoryLower} baaraw filɛ {market} kɛrɛfɛ ka taa ɲɛ SwapSpot app kɔnɔ.
directory.pairSummaryEmpty: SwapSpot bɛ {categoryLower} dɛmɛbaga misaliw labɛn {market} kɔnɔ. App da wuli ka dɛmɛbagaw filɛ i kɛrɛfɛ, baara yɔrɔw ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ filɛ ani sɔngɔ fɔli ɲini.
directory.pairSummary: {categoryLower} baara misali jamabɔlenw filɛ dɛmɛbagaw fɛ {market} lamini na. App baara kɛ ni i labɛnnen don ka cikan ci, sɔngɔ fɔli ɲini walima ka waati ta.
directory.popularBody: Nin baaraw bɛ bɔ dɛmɛbaga profili jamabɔlenw na, fɔ lisiti sinsinnen tɛ.
directory.areaBody: Peji jamabɔlenw bɛ lamini, poso kɔdi, dugu ni baara rayɔn jira walasa ɲinibagaw ka dɛmɛ sɔrɔ i kɛrɛfɛ k'a sɔrɔ gundo adirɛsiw ma jira.
directory.namesTitle: Baara tɔgɔw minnu bɛ ɲini cogo la
directory.namesBody: Dɛmɛbaga baaraw bɛ kɛ tɔgɔ ɲininen, dugu daɲɛw ani suguya pejiw ye walasa ɲinibagaw ka se ka baara tiɲɛnw ɲini.
directory.inAppTitle: Kuma ni waati taali bɛ app kɔnɔ
directory.inAppBody: Sayiti bɛ mɔgɔw dɛmɛ ka baaraw ye. SwapSpot bɛ sɔngɔ fɔliw, cikanw, waati taaliw, hakilinaw ani lakana kɔlɔsiliw mara mobile app kɔnɔ.
directory.faqTitle: Nin peji jamabɔlen bɛ baara cogo di
directory.pairFaq1Q: N bɛ se ka {categoryLower} dɛmɛbagaw waati ta {market} kɔnɔ nin peji kan wa?
directory.pairFaq1A: Nin sayiti peji ye filɛli ye dɔrɔn. SwapSpot ta walasa ka cikan ci dɛmɛbagaw ma, sɔngɔ fɔli ɲini, adirɛsi tilennen di ani waati taaliw mara.
directory.pairFaq2Q: Dɛmɛbagaw ka adirɛsi tilennen bɛ jira mɔgɔ bɛɛ ye wa?
directory.pairFaq2A: Ayi. SwapSpot bɛ baara yɔrɔ surunw dɔrɔn jira i n'a fɔ poso kɔdiw, lamini, dugu walima rayɔn. Adirɛsi tilennen bɛ to gundo la, a bɛ se ka di kuma kɔnɔ ni fan fila bɛɛ labɛnnen don dɔrɔn.
directory.pairFaq3Q: Dɛmɛbagaw bɛ SwapSpot kɔmisiyɔn sara wa?
directory.pairFaq3A: Ayi. Dɛmɛbagaw bɛ se ka profili dilan ka baaraw lisiti kɛ ka SwapSpot kɔmisiyɔn walima pɛrisɛntaji tɛ. ɲinibagaw bɛ sara donni kama ni u b'a fɛ ka cikan ci, sɔngɔ fɔli ɲini walima ka waati ta.
directory.pairListDescription: {categoryLower} baara misali jamabɔlenw minnu bɛ SwapSpot fɛ {market} kɔnɔ.
directory.cardsEmptyBody: SwapSpot bɛ dugu dɛmɛbaga profiliw da wuli sugu kɔnɔ. App ta ka baaraw filɛ i kɛrɛfɛ, sɔngɔw ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ filɛ ani ka cikan ci dɛmɛbagaw ma ni i labɛnnen don.
directory.cardsBody: Baaraw, sɔngɔw, yɔrɔw, kanw, jatew ani dɛmɛbagaw ka baara sɔrɔ ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ filɛ {market} kɛrɛfɛ. Adirɛsi tilennen ni kuman tilennen bɛ to SwapSpot kɔnɔ.
directory.cardNoDescription: Nin baara misali filɛ SwapSpot kɔnɔ, o kɔ app da wuli ka cikan ci, sɔngɔ fɔli ɲini walima ka waati ta.
directory.helperDescription: {name} bɛ {services} kɛ SwapSpot fɛ {markets} lamini na. Baara misaliw, sɔngɔw, kanw, jatew ani baara yɔrɔw ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ filɛ sani i ka app da wuli.
directory.helperDescriptionNoMarket: {name} bɛ {services} kɛ SwapSpot fɛ. Baara misaliw, sɔngɔw, kanw, jatew ani baara yɔrɔw ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ filɛ sani i ka app da wuli.
directory.previewBody: Baaraw ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ filɛ yan, o kɔ cikan ci ani waati ta app kɔnɔ.
directory.noCommissionBody: Dɛmɛbagaw bɛ baara saraw mara. SwapSpot t'a ta pɛrisɛntaji walima kɔmisiyɔn dɛmɛbaga baara la.
directory.servicesTitle: {name} bɛ se ka dɛmɛ min na
directory.servicesBody: Nin ye baara misali jamabɔlenw ye SwapSpot kan. Sɔngɔw bɛ se ka kɛ sinsinnen, lɛrɛ kelen na, ka bɔ yɔrɔ la walima ni i b'a ɲini, baara kɔrɔ la.
directory.serviceFallback: SwapSpot da wuli ka nin baara filɛ, kunnafoniw ɲini ani baara hakɛ sinsin sani i ka waati ta.
directory.areasTitle: A dilannen don dugu ɲinini kama
directory.areasBody: Dɛmɛbaga peji jamabɔlenw bɛ ɲinikɔrɔ ni ɲinibagaw di ni kunnafoni ye: baara tɔgɔw, lamini, dugu, yɔrɔ surunw ani kan taamasyɛnw. Nɔgɔn sɔrɔ kunnafoni tilennen bɛ to SwapSpot kɔnɔ.
directory.continueTitle: Cikan ci, sɔngɔ fɔli ɲini ani waati ta ni gundo kɔlɔsiliw ye.
directory.helperFaq1A: SwapSpot da wuli ka cikan ci dɛmɛbaga ma, sɔngɔ fɔli ɲini, baara kunnafoni tilennen di ani waati taali mara app kɔnɔ ni lakana ye.
directory.helperFaq2Q: Adirɛsi tilennen bɛ jira mɔgɔ bɛɛ ye wa?
directory.helperFaq2A: Ayi. Peji jamabɔlenw bɛ baara yɔrɔ surunw dɔrɔn jira i n'a fɔ lamini, dugu, poso kɔdi walima rayɔn. Adirɛsi tilennen bɛ to gundo la fo ka se mɔgɔw ka u di kuma kɔnɔ.
directory.helperFaq3Q: SwapSpot bɛ kɔmisiyɔn ta dɛmɛbagaw la wa?
directory.helperFaq3A: Ayi. Dɛmɛbagaw bɛ se ka baaraw lisiti kɛ k'a sɔrɔ SwapSpot t'a ta kɔmisiyɔn walima pɛrisɛntaji u ka baara saraw la.
directory.categoryMetaDescription: {categoryLower} dɛmɛbaga danayalenw waati ta i kɛrɛfɛ SwapSpot kan. Profiliw, sɔngɔw ani hakilinaw ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ filɛ.
directory.categoryBody: {categoryLower} baaraw filɛ dɛmɛbagaw fɛ i ka yɔrɔ la.
directory.cityMetaDescription: Dɛmɛbaga danayalenw ɲini {city} kɔnɔ saniya, dilanni, nakɔ labɛnni, bagan marali ani fɛn wɛrɛw kama.
directory.cityBody: Dɛmɛbagaw waati ta i kɛrɛfɛ saniya, dilanni, nakɔ labɛnni, yɔrɔ yɛlɛma, bagan marali, mɔgɔ kɔrɔw marali, kalan dɛmɛ ani fɛn wɛrɛw kama. SwapSpot bɛ dugumɔgɔw dɛmɛ ka baaraw, sɔngɔw, hakilinaw ani waati dɔn ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ sani u ka waati ta.
directory.cityCategoryBody: Dɛmɛbaga danayalenw ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ filɛ i kɛrɛfɛ
directory.helpersMetaTitle: Kɛ dɛmɛbaga ye - Sɔrɔ kɛ dugu kɔnɔ
directory.helpersMetaDescription: I ka dɔnniya kɛ sɔrɔ ye dugu kɔnɔ SwapSpot kan. Dɛmɛbaga profili dilan sara tɛ, i ka sɔngɔw ni waati sigi ani ɲinibagaw bɛ i waati ta.
pricing.title: Filɛ sara tɛ. Paasi baara kɛ ni i labɛnnen don ka kɛ.
pricing.body: Ɲinibagaw bɛ se ka suguyaw lajɛ ani dɛmɛbagaw ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ filɛ k'a sɔrɔ u ma sara kɛ. Paasi ka kan walasa ka cikan ci, sɔngɔ fɔli ɲini walima ka dɛmɛbaga waati ta.
pricing.freeBody: Suguyaw, dɛmɛbaga misaliw, baara yɔrɔw ani danaya taamasyɛn fɔlɔw filɛ sani i ka paasi sugandi.

pricing.plans.0.note: A ɲi baara kelen, dɛmɛ joona walima SwapSpot kɔrɔbɔ kama.

pricing.plans.1.note: A ɲi so, denbaya, ladon so walima jago mako kama minnu bɛ kɛ tuma bɛɛ.

appPreview.messageB: Awɔ! N bɛ sɔngɔ fɔli ci sisan.
forClients.title: Baara kɛ k'a sɔrɔ i ma mɔgɔw ɲini ka taa-na
forClients.body: App da wuli, dɛmɛbagaw ye i kɛrɛfɛ, profili tiɲɛnw ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ filɛ, kuma SwapSpot kɔnɔ ani waati ta ni a ɲi i ye.
forClients.cards.0.1: Suguya, jan, jate ani waati fɛ ɲini.
forClients.cards.1.0: Ɲɔgɔn kɛrɛfɛ filɛ sani i ka waati ta
forClients.cards.1.1: Profiliw, sɔngɔw, hakilinaw, fotow ani baaraw filɛ.
forClients.cards.2.1: Ɲininkaliw kɛ, kunnafoniw sinsin ani sɔngɔ fɔliw labɛn.
forClients.cards.3.1: Hakilinaw, ko fɔliw, balilenw ani kɔntɔ kɔlɔsiliw baara kɛ ni a ka kan.
cookieConsent.title: I ka gundo sugandiliw
cookieConsent.body: An bɛ Google Analytics kukiw baara ni ka kɛ ka sayiti kɔlɔsi ani ka SwapSpot ɲɛtaa. I bɛ se ka analitiki kuki wajibi tɛ minnu, olu sɔn walima ban.
maintenance.text: SwapSpot bɛ taa serivɛri kura la. Lɛrɛ kelen cɛ, donni, gundo daɲɛ kuraya ani kɔntɔ yɛlɛmaw tɛ se ka baara kɛ. I ka segin a kɔrɔbɔ dɔɔnin kɔ.
reset.title: I ka gundo daɲɛ kuraya
reset.intro: Gundo daɲɛ kura sugandi, o kɔ don SwapSpot app kɔnɔ ni i ka imɛli ni gundo daɲɛ kura ye.
reset.mismatch: Gundo daɲɛw tɛ bɛn ɲɔgɔn ma.
reset.done: I ka gundo daɲɛ yɛlɛmana. SwapSpot app da wuli ka don.
reset.invalid: Nin lyɛn tɛ ɲi walima a waati banna. A kura ɲini app kɔnɔ.
reset.openLink: I ka imɛli lyɛn da wuli ka taa ɲɛ.
reset.unavailable: Gundo daɲɛ kuraya tɛ se ka kɛ nin sayiti kan fɔlɔ.
